title: Address FileMemoryStore/FileEventStore silent-catch issues
description: Audit P1-MS-004 and P1-MS-005: FileMemoryStore (temp file cleanup) and FileEventStore (malformed JSON lines) have silent catches that hide failures. Action: add logging, consider quarantining malformed lines, and ensure errors are surfaced to monitoring. Assign to storage maintainers (out-of-scope for Agent repo).
